Good morning. Bianca Duarte, from the desk. Four numbers, and I am done. We have sixty thousand tonnes of sugar on the vessel, and we have six days to load it. There is not much time. The quota is smaller this month: the government cut it by twenty per cent, so we have less cargo and fewer trucks. There is a lot of rain in Mato Grosso this week. Every extra day costs eighteen thousand dollars. I need a few answers from you today.

Eduardo, David Hughes from the admissions office. You asked me about the numbers, so here they are. The degree has ninety credits. Sixty of them are compulsory and thirty are your choice. The tuition is twenty-two thousand dollars a year, and you can pay it in ten instalments. There is one condition for the second year: a grade of seven in every compulsory credit. We have three start dates: September, January and April. You have a few days to decide. The deadline is the thirtieth.
